scenes.description: Comparing Clean White Sneakers with Muddy Dirty Boots
Solving an Easy Jigsaw Puzzle with a Bright Smile
Asking for Another Yummy Cookie from the Glass Jar

character_line.en: Look at these two pairs of shoes by the porch! How do they look?
character_line.zh: 看門廊邊這兩雙鞋子！它們看起來怎麼樣？

options.en: These sneakers are clean, but those boots are dirty!
options.zh: 這雙球鞋很乾淨，但那雙靴子很髒！

character_line.en: The boots have mud from the rain! What should we do before entering?
character_line.zh: 靴子上沾滿了下雨時的泥巴！進屋前我們該怎麼做？

options.en: Wipe off the mud and make them clean again!
options.zh: 把泥巴擦乾淨，讓它們重新變乾淨！

options.hint: 保持家裡整潔，把髒靴子弄乾淨「clean」喔！
擦拭掉泥土，保持乾淨整齊！

character_line.en: You finished that four-piece wooden animal puzzle so fast! Was it hard?
character_line.zh: 你這麼快就拼完四片木質動物拼圖！它很難嗎？

options.en: No, it was very easy and fun for me!
options.zh: 不會，對我來說非常簡單又有趣！

options.hint: 形容不困難、容易可以用「easy（簡單的）」喔！
告訴 Benny 拼圖非常簡單好玩「very easy」！

character_line.en: Easy peasy! Should we try a different puzzle with ten pieces?
character_line.zh: 小菜一碟！那我們要不要挑戰一個十片不同的拼圖？

options.en: Yes! A different puzzle will be a cool challenge!
options.zh: 好啊！不同難度的拼圖會是個酷炫的挑戰！

options.hint: 表示不一樣或不同的可以用「different」喔！
欣然接受挑戰試試不同的拼圖吧！

character_line.en: Snack time! That crunchy chocolate cookie was so tasty! Are you still hungry?
character_line.zh: 點心時間！剛才香脆的巧克力餅乾真美味！你還會餓嗎？

options.en: May I please have another cookie from the jar?
options.zh: 我可以再從罐子裡拿另一片餅乾嗎？

options.hint: 表示「再一個、另一個」可以用「another」喔！
有禮貌地詢問可否再拿一片「another cookie」！

character_line.en: Here you go, one for you and one for me! Sharing makes food taste sweeter!
character_line.zh: 拿去吧，一片給你、一片給我！分享讓食物更甜美！

options.en: Thank you, Benny! Sharing with friends is sweet!
options.zh: 謝謝你，Benny！跟朋友分享真甜美！

options.hint: 接過餅乾跟 Benny 說聲「Thank you」喔！
享受分享美味餅乾的溫馨時刻！
